name: Nemo Clawd
description: Migrate and run Nemo Clawd inside OpenShell with DFlow spot/prediction routing and optional NIM-backed inference

blueprintVersion.description: Pinned blueprint artifact version (e.g., '0.1.0'). Omit for latest.

blueprintRegistry.description: OCI registry or GitHub release URL for blueprint artifacts

sandboxName.description: Name for the Nemo Clawd sandbox in OpenShell

inferenceProvider.description: Default inference provider type (zai, nvidia, vllm, openai-compatible)

spotTradingProvider.description: Default Solana spot trading route provider

predictionMarketProvider.description: Default Solana prediction market route provider

dflowTradeApiUrl.description: Override DFlow Trading API URL. Defaults to production when DFLOW_API_KEY is set, otherwise dev.

dflowMetadataApiUrl.description: Override DFlow prediction markets metadata API URL.

dflowMetadataApiWsUrl.description: Override DFlow prediction markets metadata websocket URL.
